provenance.instrument: Zoning Ordinance of Manheim Township 2014, as amended, published by the township as per-article PDFs in its Document Center. ADU text in Section 2515 (Article XXV)
provenance.status_detail: The township revision list shows amendments through Ordinance 2024-01, 01/22/2024. The ecode360 Chapter 500 copy is stale (through 2014). Article XXV PDF lists Ord. 2021-04, 2023-15 and 2024-01. Article PDFs read: 5 (2024), 6 and 7 (2021), 8 (2024), 9, 20 (2024), 21 (2023), 25 (2024).
provenance.code_current_through_note: Revision list: 'Revised 01/22/2024 by Ordinance 2024-01'. Ordinance of February 10, 2014, as amended.
checks: Special exception from the Zoning Hearing Board in A, R-1, R-2 and R-3 (use tables, 603.5, 703.7 and Section 2515)

Section 2515 is the specific rule: owner plus relatives by blood, marriage or adoption, and a unit above a detached garage is allowed (2515.2.A(3), (8)). The Article V definition and the township ADU permit page still describe a unit for an elderly, handicapped or disabled relative, inside the house or off a common hall. Ask the Zoning Officer which reading the township applies
The ADU permit is issued after the certificate of use and occupancy. It expires December 31 each year and is renewed with a fee (2515.2.B, township ADU permit page)
Lot must be at least 90% of the district minimum lot size: R-1 18,000, R-2 13,500, R-3 6,300 sq ft with public water and sewer (2515.2.A(13))
In the A district an ADU counts as a subdivision for lot allocation and needs one transferable development right (605.3.E, 605.3.M)
Nearest by-right alternative: duplex dwellings are a use by right in R-3 (902.4)

Article V defines 'Dwelling, carriage house' as a single dwelling on the second floor above a detached garage, max 1,000 sq ft. No district use list read names it. Article XIX (planned residential development) was not read
T-Zone Overlay rules may add use regulations. Article XXIV was only keyword searched
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Planning and Zoning Department, https://manheimtownship.org/478/Planning-Zoning. ADU permit page: https://manheimtownship.org/1170/Accessory-Dwelling-Unit-Permit. Pending: the township is rewriting its whole Zoning Ordinance (Zoning Ordinance Rewrite Project). Draft Zoning Districts and Map Report dated 08.13.26 and a draft map. Not adopted. Not law.

term.note: Section 2515 heading 'ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS'. Article V defines 'DWELLING UNIT, ACCESSORY'.

status.note: Special exception. 'Occupancy ... shall be limited to the property owner or those related by blood or marriage or adoption to the property owner.'

path.section: 2515.2, 703.7, Article VIII and IX use tables
path.note: 'Accessory dwelling units shall be permitted as a use by special exception'. Zoning Hearing Board. General standards of 2805.2 also apply.

fallback_path.note: A lot that fails a 2515 criterion, or is in another district, needs a variance from the Zoning Hearing Board. A stand-alone ground floor cottage is not a listed form (2515.2.A(3)).

value.name: Duplex dwelling (two units, not limited to family)
value.conditions: Public sewer and water required. 6,000 sq ft of lot per dwelling unit. Lot width 75 ft at the street line.

alternatives.note: 'Duplex dwellings' are a use by right in R-3 only (902.4 and the residential use table).

zoning_districts.section: 603.5, 703.7, use tables in Articles VII to IX
zoning_districts.note: Use table 'Accessory dwelling units SE SE SE' for R-1, R-2, R-3. Agricultural district 603.5 lists ADUs as a special exception.

building_types.note: Text says 'single-family dwellings'. Reading: single-family detached and semidetached. Townhouses not clear. The Article V definition names a single-family detached dwelling for the common-hall form.

min_lot_sqft.note: 'lots that are ninety (90) percent or more of the zoning district's required minimum lot size'. No single number. R-1 public sewer lot 20,000 sq ft gives 18,000.

existing_structure_only.note: 'may be constructed in either an existing or a new single-family dwelling.'

historic_bypass.note: No historic rule in 2515. Article XXIII Historic Overlay may still apply.

value.condition: 'The principal dwelling and accessory dwelling unit must be served by public sewer and public water service.'
The lot needs only 90% of the district minimum lot size.
A detached ADU is allowed only above a detached garage. Not in a basement.
An addition must keep 'the appearance of the building ... that of a single-family dwelling.'
A restoration plan, including removal of the stove, is filed with the application. The unit is removed within 90 days after the permit ends.
A district: the ADU counts as a subdivision for lot allocation and needs one transferable development right.

min_lot_share_of_district.note: 'Accessory dwelling units are permitted to be located on lots that are ninety (90) percent or more of the zoning district's required minimum lot size.'

types_allowed.note: 'contained in, or attached to, the principal dwelling or be located above a detached garage.' Not in basements.

max_sqft.note: 'nor more than one thousand (1,000) square feet, nor have more than two (2) bedrooms.'

max_share_of_house.note: 'shall not exceed forty (40) percent of the principal dwelling total floor area'

max_height_ft.note: Detached private garage: 'Maximum height: Twenty (20) feet.' Reading: applies to a garage with an ADU above. Inside or attached units use the 35 ft district height.

setback_front_ft.note: Detached garage: no structure 'between the required building setback line and the street line'.

setback_side_ft.note: Detached garage: not 'within the minimum required side yard of the prevailing district'. See districts.

setback_rear_ft.note: Detached garage: 'No structure shall be located within ten (10) feet of the rear property line.' Attached units follow the 35 ft principal rear yard.

separation_ft.note: No separation between buildings on one lot found in Articles XXI or XXII.

internal_uses_district_height.note: 'All provisions of the zoning district shall apply'. District height 35 ft.

max_building_coverage.note: Residential districts set a minimum open area (50%) instead of building coverage.

occupancy.value: The owner lives in the house or the ADU. Both units only for the owner and relatives by blood, marriage or adoption. Two bedrooms at most in the ADU.

owner_occupancy.note: 'The property owner must occupy either the principal dwelling or the accessory dwelling unit as their permanent residence.'

family_only.note: 'limited to the property owner or those related by blood or marriage or adoption to the property owner.'

short_term_rental_banned.note: Not addressed in 2515. Family-only occupancy rules out rental to others.

max_adus.note: 'Only one (1) accessory dwelling unit shall be permitted per principal dwelling.'

sale_apart_allowed.note: Not addressed. The permit ends when 'the property is sold' (2515.2.B(5)).

spaces_required.note: 'One (1) additional off-street parking space shall be provided for the accessory dwelling unit.'

total_on_site.note: Single-family detached: 'two (2.0) spaces for each dwelling unit', plus one for the ADU.

new_connection_required.note: 'must be served by public sewer and public water service.' Separate connections or meters not addressed.

min_lot_sqft.note: District minimum where both public water and public sewer are provided: 'Minimum lot area: 20,000 square feet'. An ADU lot needs 90% of it, 18,000 sq ft (2515.2.A(13), eligibility.min_lot_share_of_district). Principal yards: front 30 ft, each side 15 ft, rear 35 ft.

setback_front_ft.note: District front yard. A detached garage may not stand between the building setback line and the street (2102.4).

setback_side_ft.note: 'Side yard, each side'. A detached garage may not be in the required side yard (2102.5). An attached unit follows the principal yards.

min_lot_sqft.note: District minimum where both public water and public sewer are provided: 'Minimum lot area: 15,000 square feet'. An ADU lot needs 90% of it, 13,500 sq ft (2515.2.A(13), eligibility.min_lot_share_of_district). Principal yards: front 25 ft, each side 15 ft, rear 35 ft.

setback_front_ft.note: District front yard. A detached garage may not stand between the building setback line and the street (2102.4).

setback_side_ft.note: 'Side yard, each side'. A detached garage may not be in the required side yard (2102.5). An attached unit follows the principal yards.

min_lot_sqft.note: District minimum where both public water and public sewer are provided: 'Minimum lot area: 7,000 square feet'. An ADU lot needs 90% of it, 6,300 sq ft (2515.2.A(13), eligibility.min_lot_share_of_district). Principal yards: front 25 ft, each side 10 ft, rear 35 ft.

setback_front_ft.note: District front yard. A detached garage may not stand between the building setback line and the street (2102.4).

setback_side_ft.note: 'Side yard, each side'. A detached garage may not be in the required side yard (2102.5). An attached unit follows the principal yards.
